title: Choir and Portrait
author: Sable Nakamura
blurb: Ansel Montrose, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
